# pmtpc4 CODE-TOGGLE waivers -- MAINTAINED, not auto-generated.
# gen_exclusions.py copies the directive lines (comments stripped) into
# pmtpc4_toggle_exclusions.txt, which applies to the code-TOGGLE report ONLY (measured on
# the pmtpc4_tcov snapshot: testbench top without the bind top, no waveform dump). The
# statement/branch/condition report never sees these lines.
# Full rationale: reports/coverage_waivers.md ("2026-09-26 toggle measurement correction").
#
# REWRITTEN 2026-09-26. Every earlier "xsim tool artifact / alias blind spot" waiver
# (start_trig, pwm_level, cnt, tick_en, int_status_val, int_en_val, compare_shadow,
# cpuif_addr, and the whole-module pmtpc4_prescaler exclusion) is GONE: those zeros were
# caused by our own testbench -- an always-on $dumpvars, and bound white-box checkers --
# not by xsim's handling of the RTL. With both removed from the toggle build every one of
# those signals is measured and toggles in both directions (channel, prescaler and
# apb_slave all reach 100% with no waiver at all).
#
# --- Register block: toggle measured by functional coverage instead (option C) ---
# pmtpc4_regblock is PeakRDL-generated. xsim CANNOT measure its toggle: the field flops
# live in nested structs (field_storage / hwif_out) that xsim does not instrument for
# toggle, and the per-field `automatic` next-value temporaries it does list (next_c,
# load_next_c, is_valid_*, readback_data_var: 153 entries) are never updated and cannot be
# excluded by any name or wildcard (measured 2026-09-26). Its remaining listed nets are
# constants of this integration (wrapper resolves every error/stall/partial write) or the
# structurally-zero upper half of the 32-bit readback (every field <= 16 bits).
# Its register-storage toggle is measured instead by reg_bit_toggle_cov
# (vip/common/sv/reg_bit_toggle_cov.svh): every bit of every RAL field, 0->1 and 1->0, as
# observed in the DUT's own bus read-back -- a functional-coverage metric xsim reports
# reliably. Statement/branch/condition coverage of this module stays in the code report.
# NO LINE NEEDED HERE: gen_exclusions.py scopes every module/package under
# rdl/generated/rtl/ (pmtpc4_regblock + pmtpc4_regblock_pkg) out of the toggle report
# automatically, for any IP.
#
# --- Top level: nets constant by construction ---
# cpuif_wr_biten: driven 32'hFFFF_FFFF by pmtpc4_apb_slave (word writes only) -- never toggles.
signal -pmtpc4_tb_top.dut.cpuif_wr_biten
# cpuif_rd_data_pad: bits [31:16] of the register read-back, split out as their own net
# because every register field is <= 16 bits, so they are always zero. (The active half,
# cpuif_rd_data_active, is measured and fully toggled.)
# KNOWN xsim LIMIT (measured 2026-09-26): this net is connected into two instance ports via
# {pad, active} concatenations and xsim lists it TWICE; every exclusion form (hierarchical,
# bare, wildcard) removes only one copy. The remaining copy stays in the measured number and
# is reported as "documented constant" by run_regression.py's DUT toggle summary.
signal -pmtpc4_tb_top.dut.cpuif_rd_data_pad
